name: TDRS second/third generation (Boeing 601 design) — TDRS 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13

source.asset: Tracking and Data Relay Satellites (TDRS) (B).glb (953 KB, 20,014 triangles)
source.publisher: NASA — https://science.nasa.gov/3d-resources/tracking-and-data-relay-satellites-tdrs-b/ (credit: NASA/JPL/Eyes on the Solar System; uploaded 2025-04-16); mirrored at https://github.com/nasa/NASA-3D-Resources under '3D Models/Tracking and Data Relay Satellites (TDRS) (B)' (repo README: assets are free and without copyright)

identity.design: Second/third-generation TDRS, Boeing BSS-601 / BSS-601HP bus: two ~4.5 m flexible 'springback' mesh single-access reflectors (triangular-facet mesh with center feeds), box bus, flat circular-element S-band multiple-access array on the Earth deck, segmented solar wings on open-frame yokes, long boom omni. All features present in the model and absent from the first-generation TRW design (hexagonal bus, rib-and-mast umbrella antennas, protruding helix array) — compared in-session against NASA's published artist's concepts of both generations.
identity.generationMembership: TDRS-8/9/10 (H/I/J) built by Boeing on the BSS-601 bus with the 15-ft springback single-access antennas; TDRS-11/12/13 (K/L/M) on the BSS-601HP with the same two steerable antennas (NASA SCaN third-generation TDRS documentation, NTRS 20170010208; Boeing 601 program history). First-generation TDRS 1–7 were TRW-built and are deliberately NOT registered to this model.

processing.method: KHR_draco_mesh_compression decoded offline via scripts/earthtwin_glb_decompress.mjs (gltf-transform + draco3dgltf; also restores the spec PNG fallback `source` on EXT_texture_webp textures — the PNG twins ship inside the NASA GLB); then vertex-cluster decimation (grid 512, material+normal-octant keyed); per-vertex colors sampled from the real base-color textures (nearest texel at each vertex UV × baseColorFactor) — derived from the NASA asset, nothing invented

honesty: Decimated derivative of NASA's official TDRS model for focused-object display (72–480 px with zoom-to-inspect). The model depicts the shared second/third-generation Boeing 601 fleet design, not any single unit's exact as-flown configuration; it is registered only for the six on-orbit TDRS of that design. Geometry and colors are simplified from the source asset.
